title: The Message in a Bottle
tagline: Captain Starwave is choosing a new crew. Meet her ocean friends, collect the map, and find her treasure!

checklist: Print and cut the clue cards and the 9 map pieces
Write your treasure's hiding spot in the X box on the map before you cut it
Hide each clue card with its matching map piece, using the hiding spot guide
Put Ollie's Shell Code with Clue #4 and Sway's Seaweed Maze with Clue #5
Hide the treasure (the paper chest, treats or small prizes) at your X spot
Roll up Captain Starwave's letter in a bottle or jar, and keep Clue #1 and map piece #1 in your hand

intro.speaker: starwave
lines: Ahoy, sailors! A message in a bottle has washed ashore, and it's from Captain Starwave!
She's hanging up her captain's hat, and she's looking for a brave new crew to inherit her treasure.
Her ocean friends each guard one piece of her treasure map. Meet them all, collect every piece, and the map will show you where the treasure hides.
{name}, First Mate Finn and Mango are waiting with your first clue. Anchors aweigh!

steps.speaker: finn
steps.meet: Ahoy! I'm First Mate Finn, and this is Mango. Captain Starwave sent us to guide you. Here's map piece #1!
steps.riddle: Welcome aboard, brave crew of the sea! Fill it with bubbles and splash with glee. Where do you scrub from your head to your knee?
steps.hint: Where do you take a bath?

steps.speaker: mango
steps.meet: Squawk! Welcome to Starfish Shore! Grab map piece #2.
steps.riddle: Seagulls watch from way up high. Look through the glass where you see the sky!

steps.speaker: mango
steps.meet: Squawk! You made it to Seagull Lookout! Here's map piece #3.
steps.riddle: Eight wiggly arms are waiting for you, where the dishes get washed and the water runs too!
steps.spot: Kitchen sink, with Ollie's Shell Code page

steps.speaker: ollie
steps.meet: Hello! I'm Ollie the octopus. I guard map piece #4, and the next clue is locked in my secret shell code!
steps.riddle: Crack my shell code, one shell at a time. Each picture is a letter. The word tells you where Sway is hiding!
steps.hint: Match each picture to its letter in the key. It spells P-I-L-L-O-W.
steps.spot: A pillow or bed, with Sway's Seaweed Maze page

steps.speaker: sway
steps.meet: Swish, swish! I'm Sway the seaweed sprite. Map piece #5 is yours if you can find your way through my maze!
steps.riddle: Wiggle through my seaweed maze. Only one path finds the way. Follow it to see where the old ship lay!
steps.hint: Start at Sway and trace the path with your finger. It leads to the COUCH.
steps.spot: Under the couch or between the cushions

steps.speaker: mango
steps.meet: Squawk! You found the Hidden Shipwreck! Here's map piece #6.
steps.riddle: A crab walks sideways, left then right. Look for things that come in pairs, where you squeeze your toes in tight!
steps.hint: Look where the shoes and boots are kept.
steps.spot: Shoes or boots by the door

steps.speaker: claw
steps.meet: Click-clack! I'm Captain Claw, keeper of the gold coins. Map piece #7 is all yours!
steps.riddle: Follow my coins, they shine and glow. They lead to where your playthings go!
steps.hint: Follow the gold coins, or check the toy box.
steps.spot: Toy box or playroom (add a trail of chocolate gold coins if you like)

steps.speaker: mango
steps.meet: Squawk! The Coral Reef! So colorful! Here's map piece #8.
steps.riddle: Pearla loves stories, old and new. Look where they line up, waiting for you!

steps.speaker: pearla
steps.meet: Hello, brave crew! I'm Pearla, and this is Coral Cove. You've met every friend of the sea. Here's the last map piece!
steps.riddle: Lay your map pieces side by side. X marks where the treasure hides!
steps.hint: Put the 9 pieces together like a puzzle. The box by the X tells you where to look.
steps.spot: Wherever you wrote in the X box on the map

found: Land ho! Another piece of the map!
Ahoy! The treasure is getting closer!

finale.artAlt: Captain Starwave and the whole crew celebrating on the beach
finale.title: Treasure Found!
lines: Ahoy, {name}! You met every friend of the sea and found my treasure.
From this day on, you're an official member of Captain Starwave's crew. Fair winds and happy sailing!

print.subtitle: A printable pirate adventure where kids meet ocean friends, collect a 9-piece treasure map, and find the hidden treasure.
coverFeatures: 9-piece treasure map: X marks your spot
Shell code, seaweed maze and quest tracker
Phone Quest Master reads every clue
storyLines: After many years on the sea, I'm hanging up my captain's hat. Before I do, I need a brave new crew to inherit my treasure.
My ocean friends each guard one piece of my treasure map. Find them all, collect every piece, and put the map together. X marks the spot!
First Mate Finn and my parrot Mango will start you off. Be kind to my friends, solve their puzzles, and never give up.

storyAside.speaker: mango
storyAside.text: Squawk! Your first clue is in your hands!

startCard.speaker: starwave
startCard.title: A Message in a Bottle!
startCard.text: Ahoy! Meet my ocean friends, collect my map, and my treasure is yours!

whatToPrint: Ollie's Shell Code and Sway's Seaweed Maze
print.parentTip: Roll the letter into a clean bottle or jar and "wash it ashore" by the front door. Setup takes about 15 minutes, so do it while the crew is busy.

cipher.intro: I wrote where my friend Sway is hiding in secret shell code! Find each picture in my key, then write its letter in the box under it. Read the word and go look there!
cipher.hint: Stuck? It's where you rest your sleepy head.
cipher.speaker: ollie

tips.title: Pirate gear station
tips.text: Let sailors suit up while everyone arrives.
list: Eye patches from felt and elastic
Gold coin stickers for their quest tracker

tips.title: Set the scene
list: Play ocean waves or sea shanties
Lay a blue blanket "ocean" by the front door where the bottle washes ashore
Name the birthday kid Captain for the day

tips.title: Pirate snacks
tips.text: Save these for after the treasure is found.
list: Gold fish crackers and "seaweed" snap peas
Chocolate gold coins from Captain Claw's trail

tips.title: Find the treasure
tips.text: When the map is complete, everyone shouts "X marks the spot!" Open the treasure together, then hand out crew certificates.

certificate.title: Official Pirate Crew Member
certificate.body: for meeting every friend of the sea, cracking Ollie's code, and finding Captain Starwave's treasure.

print.backLine: If your crew loved this adventure, more quests are on the way.
